name: ZSO_USER_SHARE_DOCS
description: This table is an association table that represents the "shared" relationship between a user and a document.

columns.name: SHARE_DOC_ID
columns.description: The ID of the Document that is being shared.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The Party ID of the person with whom a document shared.  Expected to be compared with current user's Party Id (from session context) to filter "My Documents" and "All Shared Documents".

columns.name: SHARE_TYPE
columns.description: Discriminator column: indicates the type of User Share that the record represents. Valid values are "DOC" for Document and "CS" for Content Set.

columns.name: DOC_OWNER_FLAG
columns.description: Document Owner boolean value indicator.  'Y' to indicate that the Party with whom the document is shared has Ownership privileges.

columns.name: KEY_PAGE_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Shared user's preferred Key Page indicator for a page-specific thumbnail that represents that individual user's preferred thumbnail page. If null, use the Document's Default Key Page Sequence Number.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SHARED_DATE
columns.description: The date or timestamp value for document shared.
